checks.name: 1. The dialogue module is loaded with its public functions
2. Tables: at least 24 talk lines each, unique ids, valid min/max and when keys, evening tables end on default, every text key present and the plan strings verbatim
3. Copy rules: no weekday, no ₦ or digits in spoken lines, British spelling, no HTML or undefined, at most 160 characters, {item} only with decorated
4. Coverage: on every day 1-12 each neighbour has at least four lines that need no state, so three talks a day never repeat
5. No repeats: thirty talks on one day give distinct table lines and then the fallback; Nkechi’s base café line never returns; a new day resets
5a. Base hint lines: Tunde’s planter line and Nkechi’s recipe line follow the table line once a day; a base gift is always kept; silent replays agree
6. Wiring: the talk panel shows a table line with the request card above Later, gifts and their narrative stay, the rng is untouched, and a silent replay picks the same line
7. Context: watering, the placed armchair and Nkechi’s peppers pick the matching lines; with the later modules absent every talk still works
8. Party: a new household’s housewarming carries Tunde’s seedling promise and Ada’s armchair until they no longer apply; old households see nothing new
9. Evening lines: Ada follows the armchair, then the last thing placed, then her default; Tunde and Nkechi read the crop and the requests; nothing is marked used

info.lampLine: From out here I can see the lamp. You have an eye, you know. Do not let it go to your head.

method: Actual runtime state and actions in Node with the shipped Three.js and the authored hero; old households from a save, new ones through dispatch(aiStart); talks through the real openTalk and silent remote replays through applyRemote; check 7 includes a subset pass that loads the v35 modules only up to lines-v35.js. Nothing rendered here.
